findings.title: The dice look's diagnostic still says the forced look does not set the Hope and Despair role dice, which stopped being true in the same release
findings.what_happens: On Daggerheart 2.10 and later lookFindings raises rolesUnforced whenever this browser lays no table look, so with Everyone: Dice So Nice (the default; tableDualityLookFor answers null there, dice-look.mjs:154-158) the report says 'Daggerheart {version} colors its Hope and Despair dice by Dice So Nice roles, which the table's forced look does not set.' Since abe0972f the forced look is the source Gamemaster's roleAppearance too, written on every user below full Gamemaster and put back (writeLooks, putBackOverlay), and the GM handbook says so (gm-handbook.en.md:69). R5465 expects the code to be raised in exactly that view (none: ['rolesUnforced']).
findings.failure_scenario: A GM on Daggerheart 2.12.9 with the default choice presses Open the dice look (game.drpg.diagnoseDiceLook()) because a player's Hope die looked different: the report tells them the table's look does not reach the role dice, though the module has just written the GM's role looks on that player and would put the player's own back.

findings.title: The author's kept copy does not follow a card whose words were given to a second audience afterwards: a surviving victim's player who was away at an incident's close never gets its card
findings.what_happens: tellIncidentClosed posts one veiled card to the seats' players other than a living victim's ('others'), then sends the victim's own words as the same card with updateSecret(message, ..., freed). post keeps the first words on the author GM with readers = others (authorHold). updateSecret writes the author's store only when the author is among the new readers (:1350), which a GM whispering to players alone never is, so the kept entry keeps the first words and the first readers. When the victim's player comes back and asks for the card (its whisper list is the whole table, the card being veiled), answerWordsRequest finds them not among the held readers and sends nothing. A veiled card with no words is not drawn, so that player never reads 'it is over, you can act again'.
findings.failure_scenario: A direct murder closes with the victim alive while the victim's player is reloading the browser: the killer's player (connected, or back later) reads the close card; the victim's player, back ten seconds later, is given no card at all, though the stage's promise is that a private card a GM whispered to a player who was offline reaches them on return.
findings.refutation_tried: Read every caller of updateSecret (call-gm.mjs:547, :1195; migrate.mjs:1505; murder-rules.mjs:3705; reroll.mjs:770; sheet-audit.mjs:2880-2881): all but this one name readers that include the GMs or the card's own. Checked that the single-audience case is served (others empty: the card is posted to the victim's player and kept with them as its reader). Checked that this is no regression: before E38 neither group was served. Not run: 98 B posts through postSecret once and no scenario read drives an updateSecret to players alone across a return.
